Game Overview

In Glass Puzzle, the core idea is straightforward: unleash your creativity and tackle inventive challenges in Glass Puzzle. Strategically drop balls to spill glasses in cleverly designed levels. Each stage requires unique solutions, as glass-toppling becomes a captivating puzzle of physics and timing. Embrace experimentation and master the art of mess-making in this charmingly chaotic adventure.
